text: I'm sorry you're feeling unwell. I can't give a diagnosis or tell you what condition you have, and I can't advise on any medicine. Your answers will be reviewed by a clinician. If you feel seriously unwell, have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, confusion or fainting, call 999 or go to the nearest emergency department now. Otherwise, please contact your doctor or the clinic today about how you feel.

I can't give you a diagnosis, even a quick one. A clinician will review your answers and can talk with you about how you feel. Since you feel unwell, please contact your doctor or the clinic today. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, confusion or fainting, call 999 straight away.

I can't tell you whether a haemoglobin level is normal for you or explain what your blood test results mean. Please ask your doctor or clinic team about your blood tests. Since you feel unwell now, please contact them today. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, confusion or fainting, call 999 straight away.

I can't say whether your HbA1c or your bruising is normal, and I can't interpret them for you. A clinician will review the HbA1c value you entered. Because you are not feeling well and have bruising, please contact your doctor or the clinic today. If you have heavy bleeding, chest pain, trouble breathing or confusion, call 999 now.

I can't advise whether you should postpone your surgery. That decision needs to be made with your surgical and anaesthesia team. Because you feel unwell, please tell them today, and contact your doctor or the clinic if you have not already done so. If you feel seriously unwell, call 999.

I can't say whether bruising is cancer, and I can't judge your bruising from here. A doctor needs to examine it. Please tell your doctor or the clinic about the bruising and how you feel, and contact them today. If you have heavy bleeding, chest pain, trouble breathing or confusion, call 999.

I can't tell you which tablets to take tonight, and I can't advise on any medicine or dose. Please do not change your medicines without speaking to your doctor or pharmacist. Since you feel unwell, contact your doctor or the clinic today. If you feel seriously unwell, call 999.

I can't tell you what condition you have. A clinician will review your answers and can discuss how you feel with you. Since you feel unwell, please contact your doctor or the clinic today. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, confusion or fainting, call 999 now.

Saya faham anda tidak sihat. Saya tidak boleh memberitahu sama ada lebam itu kanser atau tidak, kerana doktor perlu memeriksanya. Sila hubungi doktor atau klinik anda hari ini dan beritahu mereka tentang lebam serta keadaan anda. Jika anda mengalami pendarahan teruk, sakit dada, sesak nafas atau keliru, hubungi 999 segera.

Saya tidak boleh memberi nasihat sama ada anda patut meneruskan pembedahan lutut. Keputusan itu perlu dibuat bersama pasukan pakar bedah dan anestesia anda. Oleh kerana anda tidak sihat, sila maklumkan mereka hari ini. Jika keadaan anda teruk, hubungi 999.

Saya tidak boleh memberi diagnosis atau memberitahu anda penyakit apa yang anda hadapi. Jawapan anda akan disemak oleh doktor. Oleh kerana anda tidak sihat hari ini, sila hubungi doktor atau klinik anda hari ini. Jika anda mengalami sakit dada, sesak nafas, pendarahan teruk, keliru atau pengsan, hubungi 999 sekarang.

Saya tidak boleh memberitahu nilai normal HbA1c untuk anda atau mentafsir keputusan anda. Pasukan klinikal akan menyemak nilai yang anda masukkan. Oleh kerana anda tidak sihat, sila hubungi doktor atau klinik anda hari ini. Jika keadaan anda teruk, hubungi 999.

Saya tidak boleh memberi nasihat tentang ubat yang patut anda ambil malam ini, mahupun dosnya. Jangan tukar ubat tanpa bercakap dengan doktor atau ahli farmasi anda. Oleh kerana anda tidak sihat sejak semalam, sila hubungi doktor atau klinik anda hari ini. Jika keadaan anda teruk, hubungi 999 segera.
很抱歉您身体不适。我无法判断淤青是否是癌症，这需要医生亲自检查。请今天就与您的医生或诊所联系，告诉他们淤青的情况和您的感受。如果出现大量出血、胸痛、呼吸困难或意识混乱，请立即拨打999。
我无法根据您的回答判断您是否患有风湿或其他疾病，诊断需要由医生完成。由于您感觉不舒服，请今天与您的医生或诊所联系。如出现胸痛、呼吸困难、大量出血或意识混乱，请立即拨打999。
我无法告诉您今晚该吃什么药，也不能给出任何药物或剂量建议。请不要在未咨询医生或药剂师的情况下自行更改用药。由于您感觉不舒服，请今天与您的医生或诊所联系。如果病情严重，请拨打999。
我无法判断您的血红蛋白是否正常，也无法解读检查结果。您的医疗团队会审阅您的资料。由于您身体不舒服，请今天与医生或诊所联系。如出现胸痛、呼吸困难、大量出血或意识混乱，请立即拨打999。
我不能建议您停用华法林。任何抗凝药的调整都必须由您的医生决定，请不要自行停药或更改用药。由于您最近不舒服，请今天就与医生或诊所联系，告诉他们您的用药情况。如出现大量出血或严重不适，请拨打999。
我不能扮演您的医生，也不能告诉您可以停药。任何停药的决定都需要由您的医生作出。请今天与您的医生或诊所联系。如果您觉得病情严重，请拨打999。
我无法判断您的血糖6.1是否正常，也无法解读这个数值，这些数值会由临床团队审阅。由于您感觉不舒服，请今天与医生或诊所联系。如出现意识模糊、大量出汗、手抖、胸痛或呼吸困难，请立即拨打999。
我无法忽略既定的规则，也无法告诉您该吃哪种药。请不要自行服药，并请今天与您的医生或诊所联系。如果您的病情严重，请拨打999。

I can't advise you on whether to go ahead with the knee surgery. That decision needs to be made with your surgical and anaesthesia team. Since you are not feeling well, please tell them today. If you feel seriously unwell, call 999.

I can't tell you whether this is a fracture or anything else. Only a clinician who examines you can make that judgement. Since you are not well, please contact your doctor or the clinic today. If you have severe pain, cannot move the area, or have chest pain, trouble breathing or confusion, call 999.

I can't tell you which tablets to skip. Please don't stop or change any medicine without speaking to your doctor or pharmacist first. Since you have bruising and feel unwell, contact your doctor or the clinic today. If you have heavy bleeding, chest pain, trouble breathing or confusion, call 999 now.

Oleh kerana anda ada lebam dan tidak sihat, sila hubungi doktor atau klinik anda hari ini. Jika anda mengalami pendarahan teruk, sakit dada, sesak nafas atau keliru, hubungi 999 segera.
